purpose: Sixteen original balanced evaluation cases with explicit rule/geometry/guide/finished-pixel boundaries. This catalogue is not sixteen generators or sixteen generated illustrations.
execution_policy: Test names and source paths were checked for existence. Consolidated test execution, release validation and any image-specific observations must come from their own recorded runs. No test-count or final-art completion claim is made here.

inventory.distinction: Thirteen recipe-based examples coexist with sixteen executable bounded evaluation questions. A validated component fixture never implies a complete unsupported subject materializer. Legacy coverage remains explicit.

acceptance_policy: Every critical physical failure blocks that physical claim; artistic preference never compensates.
Unsupported adapters remain unsupported before finishing.
Guide checks do not authorize final-pixel observations.
A final image needs its own bound review record; absent evidence stays deferred.
Use fixed geometry/view for context, light or material ablations and record any changed input.

cases.name: Mountain bunker organizations
cases.short_prompt: Draw a mountain bunker with connected occupied levels.
cases.decision: Preserve the requested level count; compare hub, spine and branched materializers with real apertures and stairs. Actors require an explicit actor brief/plan.

evidence.rules: Named source contracts and tests present; final suite verdict recorded separately.
evidence.geometry: Executable original/bounded fixture: complete registered pilot. The runner validates its actual geometry and rejects mutation stair_support; its full report retains partial legacy coverage.
evidence.guide: The runner renders the actual fixture and records owned pixels of core-stair-0; a hidden target fails its regression. These observations are not a full artistic or recognition verdict.
evidence.finished_pixels: deferred: no final-image observation record is bundled or claimed for this case

cases.negative_case: Removing a physical support cannot be excused by hiding the facade in the display cut.
cases.unsupported_or_unverified: The originally proposed stepped comparison is unsupported; branched is the implemented third organization. The new complete fixture does not add workers implicitly. Geotechnical and structural performance are unverified. Room-kit footprint/translation limits are explicit; program furniture does not certify process or human performance.
